// The involute of a circle of radius Radius: the path of a taut string
// unwinding from the circle, over the unwinding-angle interval. The profile
// of standard gear teeth (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Involute).
type CircleInvolute2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    Radius: Number;
    Angles: AngleInterval;
}

//==
// # Roulettes (rolling-circle curves)
//
// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roulette_(curve).

// The path of a point on the rim of a circle of radius Radius rolling along
// the X axis: x = Radius * (theta - sin theta), y = Radius * (1 - cos theta),
// with the rolling angle theta swept over Angles
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cycloid).
type Cycloid2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    Radius: Number;
    Angles: AngleInterval;
}

// The path of a rim point on a circle of radius RollingRadius rolling outside
// a fixed circle of radius FixedRadius. Closes after a whole number of laps
// when the radius ratio is rational; the canonical parameter covers one lap
// around the fixed circle (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epicycloid).
type Epicycloid2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    FixedRadius: Number;
    RollingRadius: Number;
}

// The path of a rim point on a circle of radius RollingRadius rolling inside
// a fixed circle of radius FixedRadius. Straight lines, ellipses, and the
// astroid arise from particular radius ratios
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hypocycloid).
type Hypocycloid2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    FixedRadius: Number;
    RollingRadius: Number;
}

// A generalized epicycloid: the traced point sits PoleDistance from the center
// of the rolling circle rather than on its rim (spirograph curves)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epitrochoid).
type Epitrochoid2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    FixedRadius: Number;
    RollingRadius: Number;
    PoleDistance: Number;
}

// A generalized hypocycloid: the traced point sits PoleDistance from the center
// of the circle rolling inside the fixed circle (spirograph curves)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hypotrochoid).
type Hypotrochoid2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    FixedRadius: Number;
    RollingRadius: Number;
    PoleDistance: Number;
}

//==
// # Analytic curves in 3D
//
// Named closed-form space curves. Planar arcs carry a Frame3D whose origin is
// the curve center and whose XY plane contains the curve; spirals and knots
// wind about the frame's Z axis. The canonical [0,1] parameter maps onto the
// documented sweep.

//==
// # Planar arcs in space

// A circular arc in space: radius Radius about the frame origin, in the
// frame's XY plane, swept over Angles measured from the frame's X axis
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circular_arc).
type CircularArc3D
    implements IPlanarCurve3D
{
    Frame: Frame3D;
    Radius: Number;
    Angles: AngleInterval;
}

// An elliptical arc in space: semi-axis lengths Radii along the frame's X and
// Y axes, swept over the parametric angle interval
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellipse).
type EllipticalArc3D
    implements IPlanarCurve3D
{
    Frame: Frame3D;
    Radii: Number2;
    Angles: AngleInterval;
}

//==
// # Polynomial arcs

// A quadratic Bezier arc in space: interpolates P0 to P2, shaped by the middle
// control point P1 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A9zier_curve).
type QuadraticBezier3D
    implements ICurve3D, IDeformable3D
{
    P0: Point3D;
    P1: Point3D;
    P2: Point3D;
}

// A cubic Bezier arc in space: interpolates P0 to P3, shaped by the interior
// control points P1 and P2 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A9zier_curve).
type CubicBezier3D
    implements ICurve3D, IDeformable3D
{
    P0: Point3D;
    P1: Point3D;
    P2: Point3D;
    P3: Point3D;
}

//==
// # Helices and spirals

// A circular helix winding about the frame's Z axis at distance Radius,
// rising Pitch per full turn (right-handed for positive Pitch), swept over
// the angle interval (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Helix).
type Helix
    implements ICurve3D
{
    Frame: Frame3D;
    Radius: Number;
    Pitch: Number;
    Angles: AngleInterval;
}

// A spiral on a cone about the frame's Z axis: the winding radius interpolates
// across Radii while the curve climbs Height over the full sweep of Angles
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conical_spiral).
type ConicalSpiral3D
    implements ICurve3D
{
    Frame: Frame3D;
    Radii: NumberInterval;
    Height: Number;
    Angles: AngleInterval;
}
